reason: The plan hits every hard requirement (≤12 numbered steps, rollback, rehearsal, integrity verification, stakeholder communication, backup-before-destructive-action ordering) with a coherent CDC/logical-replication strategy suited to the 2TB/2-hour-window constraint, and includes non-obvious details like sequence/index/constraint checks and backup-restore validation, though it stops short of addressing logical replication limitations like DDL/large-object handling in more depth.
